name: 02543 · Woods Hole, MA
findings: ZIP 02543 (Woods Hole) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02543 (Woods Hole) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02543 (Woods Hole) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 13% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 research and think tank organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
